* skopeo: golang net/url: Denial of Service from quadratic complexity in path resolution (CVE-2026-56860)

* skopeo: Go net/http: Unencrypted HTTP/2 connections vulnerable to Denial of Service (CVE-2026-56853)

* skopeo: Golang crypto/tls: Denial of Service via indefinite KeyUpdate messages (CVE-2026-56862)
